name: Postpartum Support International 40th Annual Conference 2027
description: The 40th PSI Annual Conference will be held in Chicago with preconference trainings July 7 to 8, 2027 and the main conference July 8 to 11, 2027. PSI expects more than 1,400 attendees; hotel and proposal details are not yet posted.
